{{Quote|He's not even a Force-user. But he knows where they are, and he's been getting them out via a refugee network. He's an Antarian Ranger.|[[Sa Cuis]] on Jilam Kester|<ref name="IC 501st" />}}
'''Jilam Kester''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Rangers]].<ref name="IC 501st" />

Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kester took part in helping [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escape through refugee networks from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Jedi hunter/Legends|hunters]]. Kester's assistance did not go unnoticed as he was given as a target for [[Squad 40]], one of the [[Clone commando/Legends|Imperial commando]] squads belonging to the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. Squad 40 tried to capture Kester on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celen]] where he was hiding. Unbeknownst to the commandos, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Iri Camas]] was with Kester at the time. Camas [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] himself and distracted the commandos, thereby allowing Kester to escape.<<ref name="IC 501st" />
